entities.name: PMID:10735904
observations: Phase II study of vinorelbine in 36 patients with AIDS-related Kaposi sarcoma progressing after at least one systemic chemotherapy regimen.
Vinorelbine was administered at 30 mg/m² intravenously every 2 weeks.
Among 35 assessable patients, complete response was 9% and partial response 34%, for an objective response rate of 43% (95% CI 26%-61%).
Median response duration was 176 days; median progression-free survival was 151 days and median survival was 216 days.
Treatment was generally well tolerated; toxicity including neurologic toxicity was mild and reversible, with neutropenia the most frequent dose-limiting toxicity.
Single-arm phase II evidence supports activity and short-term tolerability but does not establish comparative efficacy or safety.

entities.name: Vinorelbine
observations: In PMID:10735904, vinorelbine monotherapy produced a 43% objective response rate in previously chemotherapy-treated AIDS-related Kaposi sarcoma.
In PMID:10735904, the principal dose-limiting toxicity was neutropenia; reported toxicity was mild and reversible overall.

entities.name: AIDS-related Kaposi sarcoma
observations: The PMID:10735904 population had advanced disease with progression after one or more systemic chemotherapy regimens.
The study evaluated vinorelbine monotherapy at 30 mg/m² intravenously every 2 weeks.
